tags: Illustrative scenario: not a Region plan

words.text: Sites ranked by a stated rule.

scenes.notes: The flashiest beat of the first drop, on row-2027-budget's Construction tab. Bar 30: the map with the ranked candidate launch and extraction sites, the twin bores, boreholes and cross-passages. 31.1: the long-section with the animated TBM. 31.3 to 33.1: stepping 1 to 7, each step's render zooming past (about one every 0.86 beat) under the product's own step title, from 'Drill boreholes to read the ground' to 'Fit out, then give the land back'. The renders are the product's own files (data/renders); the recorder also captures the map flying between steps (clip scout-steps) if we'd rather cut to that.

facts.text: Scenario: 'What if ION Stage 2 went under Highway 401 and the Speed River? A 2.9 km twin-bore tunnel between Sportsworld and Preston', labelled 'Illustrative scenario: not a Region plan'
